title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Cirrhosis
intro: Herbal creams for Cirrhosis are topical treatments made from plant extracts that are used to alleviate the symptoms and slow down the progression of liver cirrhosis. These creams often contain a blend of herbs such as milk thistle, turmeric, aloe vera, and licorice root, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat cirrhosis include reducing liver inflammation, improving liver function, and promoting overall liver health, as seen in creams like LivMax, Liv 52, and Liver Care. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat cirrhosis include Arjuna cream, which is believed to improve liver function, and Silymarin cream, which is known for its antioxidant properties in protecting the liver.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum creams, derived from the milk thistle plant, are herbal preparations used to treat cirrhosis, a liver disease characterized by scarring of the liver tissue. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of silymarin, a bioactive constituent of Silybum marianum, help to protect the liver from further damage and promote liver cell regeneration. This herbal preparation works by inhibiting the production of liver enzymes that cause inflammation and oxidative stress, thereby reducing liver damage and improving liver function. The benefits of Silybum marianum creams in treating cirrhosis include reduced liver inflammation, improved liver function, and slowed progression of liver disease, making it a popular natural remedy for liver health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytotherapy research : PTR", Silybum marianum creams for cirrhosis may be beneficial as silymarin, derived from Silybum marianum, has shown beneficial effects on cirrhosis, including improvements in liver enzymes such as AST and ALT, in three out of six studies.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa creams, derived from the turmeric plant, have shown promise in treating cirrhosis, a chronic liver disease characterized by scarring and liver damage. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of curcuma longa creams help to reduce liver inflammation, improve liver function, and prevent further liver damage. The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, have been shown to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, which contribute to liver damage. The benefits of using curcuma longa creams to treat cirrhosis include improved liver function, reduced liver inflammation, and a decreased risk of liver cancer and liver failure.
preparations.preparation_study: According to Phytotherapy research : PTR, Curcuma longa creams for cirrhosis have shown beneficial effects, specifically an improvement in alkaline phosphatase (ALP), bilirubin, prothrombin time (PT), and the international normalized ratio (INR).

The bioactive constituents, such as glycyrrhizin and flavonoids, possess potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities that contribute to the treatment of cirrhosis. The benefits of using Glycyrrhiza glabra creams to treat cirrhosis include reduced liver damage, improved liver function, and enhanced overall well-being, making it a promising natural remedy for this debilitating condition.
